dict.string: ORBIT shows the contents of your Desktop folder in Files and includes it in storage analyses you start. Nothing leaves this Mac.
ORBIT shows the contents of your Documents folder in Files and includes it in storage analyses you start. Nothing leaves this Mac.
ORBIT shows the contents of your Downloads folder in Files and includes it in storage analyses you start. Nothing leaves this Mac.
ORBIT shows files on removable drives in Files and analyses their storage when you ask for it.
ORBIT shows files on network drives in Files when you open them.
macOS only reveals the name of the Wi‑Fi network to apps with location access. ORBIT uses it for nothing else and never stores your location.
